subtitleNullable: OOF + test predictions for 22 S6E10 models on the standard 5-fold split
descriptionNullable:
Out-of-fold (OOF) and test predictions for 22 models trained for Playground S6E10 (Predicting Airline Satisfaction), built for stacking.

- Each .npz file holds `oof` (699,635 rows, train.csv order) and `test` (299,844 rows, test.csv order).
- Outer split for all members: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over train.csv in file order, the same split as most public S6E10 OOF libraries, so arrays line up row for row. Members ending in `_k10` were trained on 10 folds (same seed); their OOF is still one out-of-fold prediction per row.
- Models: RealMLP, LightGBM, XGBoost and CatBoost with route-profile, target-encoding, original-data-teacher and auxiliary "expected rating" features. Recipes, seeds, per-fold AUCs and runtimes are in members.json.
- aux_ev.parquet: 13 label-free auxiliary features (expected value of each rating predicted from the other 20 columns), train rows first, then test rows.
- Early stopping used a 5% inner split of each fold's training rows, never the validation fold; target encodings were fitted inside folds.

No competition data, labels or ids are included. Predictions only.

Companion notebook: https://www.kaggle.com/code/sachith7/s6e10-lb-0-96134-what-each-step-was-worth
